colors.strategy: High contrast, data-first. Use existing CSS variables (--primary, --background, --card) but enforce strict border colors and semantic text tones.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 or gap-6. Row 1: 5 stat cards spanning 1 col each on LG. Row 2: Illaka Table (lg:col-span-2) + Recovery Graph (lg:col-span-3).
layout_and_spacing.container: p-4 md:p-8 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto flex flex-col gap-6

cards.base: bk-card relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col justify-between

badges.recovery_high: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold bg-green-100 text-green-800 border border-green-200 dark:bg-green-900/40 dark:text-green-400 dark:border-green-800
badges.recovery_medium: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border border-yellow-200 dark:bg-yellow-900/40 dark:text-yellow-400 dark:border-yellow-800
badges.recovery_low: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200 dark:bg-red-900/40 dark:text-red-400 dark:border-red-800

table.wrapper: rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden bg-card text-sm

charts.style: Use ComposedChart for Utaar/Vayda (Bar) with Line overlay for Recovery %. Use hsl(var(--primary)) for Vayda and hsl(var(--muted-foreground)) with low opacity for Utaar. Minimal grid lines.

header.description: Greeting 'Namaste, {name}' and current Date. Right-aligned avatar.

illaka_table.description: Compact list/table showing breakdown per Illaka.

recovery_graph.description: Bar + Line chart for Financial Year.

images.usage: Top right header user profile picture

icons.usage_rules: Use stroke-width 1.5. Colors must match the text-muted-foreground unless active/alert.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Control Room' grid layout: tight data-dense configuration using CSS grid (lg:grid-cols-5).
Ensure bilingual text implementation where Hindi labels sit directly below English labels using the defined bk-label-en and bk-label-hi classes from index.css or the typography scale defined.
Do NOT use placeholder text or external URLs not defined in media_assets.
Rely on existing tailwind classes and CSS variables. Expand custom classes only via Tailwind utility classes directly in React components.
Make sure Recharts components are responsive (ResponsiveContainer) and use theme CSS variables for colors.
Include hover states on table rows and cards for an interactive feel.
Implement the 'Year Recovery Graph' using a ComposedChart (Bar for Utaar/Vayda, Line for Recovery %).
All cards must have the bk-card class applied.
